term: Reserve stock
id: REQ-RESERVE
---

# Reserve stock

The service reserves units from an [[item]].
A successful [[reservation]] reduces available stock by its quantity.
The service rejects unknown items, duplicate reservation identifiers, and quantities above available stock.
A failed operation does not change stock or reservations.

---
term: Release stock
id: REQ-RELEASE
---

# Release stock

The service releases an active [[reservation]].
Release restores its quantity to the [[item]] and changes its status to released.
Repeated release succeeds without changing stock.
The service rejects an unknown reservation.

---
term: Validate quantities
id: REQ-VALIDATION
---

# Validate quantities

A [[reservation]] quantity must be a positive safe integer.
Identifiers must contain a non-whitespace character.
The service rejects invalid inputs before it writes data.
The database rejects invalid quantities, statuses, and missing item references.

@REQ-RESERVE
Feature: Reserve available stock
  @SCN-RESERVE
  Scenario: Reserve part of the available stock
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 3 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the operation succeeds
    And 2 units remain available
    And 1 reservations exist

  @SCN-INSUFFICIENT
  Scenario: Reject a reservation above available stock
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 6 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "insufficient_stock"
    And 5 units remain available
    And 0 reservations exist

  @SCN-COMPETING
  Scenario: A second reservation cannot spend reserved stock
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 3 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the operation succeeds
    When I reserve 3 units of "widget" with ID "r2"
    Then the error is "insufficient_stock"
    And 2 units remain available
    And 1 reservations exist

  @SCN-DUPLICATE
  Scenario: Reject a repeated reservation identifier
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 2 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the operation succeeds
    When I reserve 2 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "duplicate_reservation"
    And 3 units remain available
    And 1 reservations exist

  @SCN-UNKNOWN-ITEM
  Scenario: Reject an unknown item
    When I reserve 2 units of "missing" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "unknown_item"
    And 0 reservations exist

@REQ-RELEASE
Feature: Release reserved stock once
  @SCN-RELEASE
  Scenario: Release and repeat the release
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 3 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the operation succeeds
    When I release reservation "r1"
    Then the operation succeeds
    And 5 units remain available
    When I release reservation "r1"
    Then the operation succeeds
    And 5 units remain available
    And 1 reservations exist

  @SCN-UNKNOWN-RESERVATION
  Scenario: Reject an unknown reservation
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I release reservation "missing"
    Then the error is "unknown_reservation"
    And 5 units remain available

@REQ-VALIDATION
Feature: Validate reservation quantities
  @SCN-ZERO
  Scenario: Reject zero units
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 0 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "invalid_input"
    And 5 units remain available
    And 0 reservations exist

  @SCN-NEGATIVE
  Scenario: Reject negative units
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve -1 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "invalid_input"
    And 5 units remain available
    And 0 reservations exist

  @SCN-FRACTION
  Scenario: Reject fractional units
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 1.5 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "invalid_input"
    And 5 units remain available
    And 0 reservations exist

  @SCN-UNSAFE
  Scenario: Reject an unsafe integer
    Given item "widget" has 5 available units
    When I reserve 9007199254740992 units of "widget" with ID "r1"
    Then the error is "invalid_input"
    And 5 units remain available
    And 0 reservations exist
